figures.finding: Uruguay's Wage Council for Group 18, subgroup 09 (artists), chapter on independent non-advertising audiovisual production, agreed on 23 December 2025 the minimum conditions for actors and technicians nationwide, signed for workers by the Sociedad Uruguaya de Actores, Gremiocine and APU and for employers by ANDEBU and ASOPROD; it runs 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2027, adjusts the sector's pay 1.57% from 1 July 2025, 3.3% from 1 January 2026, 2.8% from 1 July 2026 and 3.2% from 1 January 2027, has SUA publish the totals of nominal pay with statutory items after each adjustment, and raises the minimums 25% for a film without the Agency's national or co-production certificate. Until 2026-11-04 this figure held the round of 1 October 2018, which ran to 30 June 2020.

value.name: Acuerdo de Consejo de Salarios, Grupo 18, Subgrupo 09, Capítulo "Producción audiovisual independiente no publicitaria", Undécima Ronda

figures.applies: Uruguay, independent film and audiovisual productions, 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2027; the acta is a scan, quoted from its page images.

sources.said: ACUERDO. En la ciudad de Montevideo, el 23 de diciembre de 2025, reunido el Consejo de Salarios del Grupo 18 "Servicios Culturales, de esparcimiento y comunicaciones", subgrupo 09, Artistas y actividades conexas", Capítulo "Producción audiovisual independiente no publicitaria" … y las Sras. Susana Acosta en representación de la Sociedad Uruguaya de Actores (SUA) … Las disposiciones del acuerdo son de aplicación en todo el territorio de la República y establece las condiciones mínimas favorables para los actores y técnicos. … SEGUNDO. VIGENCIA Y OPORTUNIDAD DE LOS AJUSTES SALARIALES. El acuerdo tendrá vigencia entre el 1ero de julio de 2025 y el 30 de junio de 2027 (24 meses). … NOVENO. Ajuste de salarios mínimos y sobrelaudos al 1ero de julio de 2026. Todos los salarios vigentes al 30 de junio de 2026 tendrán un ajuste de 2.8%. … DÉCIMO SEGUNDO: … En todas las oportunidades en que existan ajustes de salarios, se publicará en las páginas web www.sua.org.uy y www.asoprod.org.uy y el blog, www.gremiocine.blogspot.com el cálculo total del nominal más rubros. DÉCIMO TERCERO: a) Cuando las obras cinematográficas no obtengan de la Agencia del Cine y el Audiovisual el certificado de proyecto de obra en co-producción o de obra nacional, los salarios mínimos por categorías aquí establecidos tendrán un incremento del 25%

figures.finding: SUA's minimum rates for film and TV from January 2026 are a fee of $135,563 for a lead, $110,798 for a co-lead, $61,480 for a supporting part, $16,944 for a small part of up to two days ($33,890 from three days) and $4,691 for a featured extra, each plus a $4,691 day rate, in Uruguayan pesos including statutory items; the engager adds 11.125% for employer health contributions and the cooperative's costs, and a day runs up to 10 hours with at most 2 hours' overtime. These are the totals the Wage Council's agreement of 2025 has SUA publish; the sheet calls the film figure the feature's fee ("Cachet de Largometraje") and pays a short film 10% of it "más jornal", so the game reads it as a fee for the part beside a day rate for each day. It is SUA's latest: its uploads, listed on 2026-11-04, end with January 2026's, before the 2.8% adjustment of 1 July 2026.

figures.finding: For advertising, SUA's January 2026 minimums for image and voice are $25,420 for a lead for one month's use ($39,100 for a year), $20,324 for a co-lead and $15,224 for a secondary part, before VAT; work outside Montevideo's media is 50% less.

sources.said: Para el interior un 50% de descuento. Precios válidos para anunciantes y medios de cada localidad, se excluyen anunciantes nacionales y medios con cobertura en Montevideo.

figures.finding: The actors' union is the Sociedad Uruguaya de Actores (SUA), founded in 1941, a founding union of the PIT-CNT and a member of the International Federation of Actors; one joins by contacting its team.
